trigger_rule: Active Power Surge > 2100 W and Power Factor < 0.72
root_cause: Capacitor degradation or mechanical locked rotor stalling in high-ambient conditions
recommended_action: Emergency automated breaker trip; inspect dual run capacitor and refrigerant pressure

trigger_rule: High Draw (>2000 W) Active during Evening Peak (18:00-22:00)
root_cause: Manual immersion heater switch-on during grid peak surcharge hours
recommended_action: Shift schedule to 05:30-07:00 off-peak buffer; potential monthly savings of ₹320

trigger_rule: Continuous Standby Power > 45 W for > 4 hours during 01:00-05:00
root_cause: Workstation peripherals, dual monitors, and external thunderbolt docks remaining in standby
recommended_action: Auto-isolate smart relay on channel CT-CH04 after 30 minutes of idle state

trigger_rule: Aggregate Load > 5000 W Sanctioned Contract Demand
root_cause: Concurrent operation of Water Heater, Air Conditioner, and Washing Machine heating cycle
recommended_action: Automated demand response (DSM) shed priority-3 loads: delay washing machine wash cycle
